intent.goal: Verify SDK file writing/read-back and shell calculation capabilities.
intent.acceptance: Protected independent native file and process observations establish source-prescribed effects. Partial byte/operation facets, full task conjunction, required issue reporting and SDK contribution are separate.

historicalContext.reason: Actual introduction Markdown/compiled originals and real-parent addition establish adoption, not applicability of the later goal. Introduction tested repository analysis/issue/label/comment work. Only the October17 run has verified matching file/readback/arithmetic source/import/SDK capture originals; every other era remains unknown.
historicalContext.predecessor: predecessor-v1.json.gz retains the complete prior instrument, actual frozen standard rejection and prospective null report; no historical activation date was invented.

metrics.name: New files with prescribed content
metrics.formula: Count independent absent-before/regular-file-after observations at the exact run path with prescribed prefix and nonempty date/time text; current clock correctness remains separate.

metrics.name: Native cat phrase readbacks

metrics.name: Exact native bash calculations
